apiField: Trusted model outputs as input assets
summary: Face-containing outputs generated under the same account can be fed back in without tripping input moderation. Scope: face-containing videos from Seedance 2.5/2.0 (trusted from March 11, 2026), their last-frame images (from April 16, 2026), and face-containing images from Seedream 5.0 lite text-to-image (from April 16, 2026).
combines: Supported on: input to Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0 series
ModelArk outputs only, same account only, original files only. Secondary editing, compression, or forwarding can void the trust.
Trust applies to input moderation only; output can still be blocked by security moderation.
Only relevant when face moderation would trigger; face-free outputs are freely reusable.
Video URLs live 24 hours, so transfer to your own TOS bucket (TOS data subscription) before reusing.
range: 30-day validity from the output's generation time
